New Brief

Assign work like sending an email.

Select everyone who should work on this brief. Each selected person receives the brief and their own task acknowledgement.
Creative Director — mandatory copy unless assigned TO
Deputy Creative Director — mandatory copy unless assigned TO
Traffic Manager — copied on briefs sent by Account Management
Managing Director — copied on briefs sent by Account Management
Dr. Kunbi — copied on briefs sent by Account Management
Account Managers send directly to the selected working team. Traffic receives an automatic copy for scheduling oversight. The sender is never duplicated as a CC.
Select several files in one go. Total attachments: up to 20 MB per send. For larger work, add a view-only Drive / Frame.io / other work link instead. They are securely stored with the brief in ONIT.
